title: William H Morgan
clean_html:
William H Morgan

Preserved Primary Document • morgan-w.htm

Sometime prior to 1840 he married {Mary?} Annie Saunders (b.c. 1819) and they had, at least, 6 children: John H. Morgan (1840-1925) married Mary Ann Coker Elizabeth Morgan (b.1841) Sarah Morgan (b.1843) Rebecca Morgan (b.1845) Alsey Morgan (b.1849) James K. Morgan (1851-1931) married Araminta Sisco Sometime before 1858, Annie died and William married, Mahala DURHAM who was the widow of William Durham and the daughter of Isaiah Songo . They had the following children: William Morgan (b.1860) Albert Morgan (b.1863) Margaret Morgan (b.1868) William and his son, John H. Morgan, bought land from the estate of Robert Dean and lived side by side along the main highway, the present Rt. 13. John's brother-in-law , Moses Coker , was married to Robert's daughter, Mary Ann Dean. On 12 April, 1891 William Morgan died. He is buried at Immanuel Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold, DE.
